column3: “These are the words of” renders “these things says”; “among” renders “in [the] midst of.”
“Deeds” renders ἔργα; “exposed as liars those who falsely claim” recasts “tested those calling themselves apostles and they are not, and found them false.”
BSB follows the critical text with no “you have labored” (κεκοπίακας); it adds “many things” and moves “without growing weary” to the front.
Close to the Greek.
BSB follows the critical text with no “quickly.” “Keep in mind how far you have fallen” renders “remember from where you have fallen”; “if you do not repent” is added in the second sentence.
“To your credit” is added.
“Grant the right to eat” renders “give to eat”; BSB leaves out “My” before “God.”
“Died and returned to life” renders “became dead and came to life.”
BSB follows the critical text with no “your works” (the Textus Receptus has them). “I am aware of” is added; “falsely claim” and “in fact” are added.
“Look” renders ἰδοὺ; “to test you” renders “so that you may be tested.”
Close to the Greek.
“Holds” renders “has.”
BSB follows the critical text with no “your works,” which the Textus Receptus has. “Sits” is added; “your faith in Me” renders “My faith.”
“Some of you” renders “[some] there”; “the Israelites” renders “the sons of Israel”; “so they would” recasts “and.”
BSB follows the critical text with “in the same way” (the Textus Receptus has “which I hate”).
“Shortly” renders ταχὺ.
BSB follows the critical text with no “to eat”; “known only to” recasts “which no one knows except.”
“Blazing fire” renders “a flame of fire”; “polished bronze” renders χαλκολιβάνῳ.
BSB follows the critical-text order “love, faith, service.”
“That woman” renders “the woman of you”; “by her teaching she misleads” recasts “and she teaches and misleads.”
BSB follows the critical text with “she is unwilling” (θέλει); “even though” is added.
“A bed of sickness” renders κλίνην (“bed”); BSB follows the critical text with “her deeds.”
“Strike her children dead” renders “kill her children with death”; “minds” renders νεφροὺς (“kidneys”).
“So-called” renders “as they say”; “learned” renders “known.”
Close to the Greek.
“Continues in My work” renders “keeps My works.”
“Iron scepter” renders “rod of iron”; BSB includes here “just as I have received authority from My Father,” which the Greek counts as verse 28, and adds “authority.”
BSB has here only the morning star; “just as I have received from My Father” stands in verse 27.
Close to the Greek.
